title: Rebranded Galapagos finally finds buyer for unwanted cell therapy pipeline
summary: Lakefront Biotherapeutics—the new name for Belgium’s Galapagos Therapeutics—has found a buyer for its unwanted cell therapy pipeline.

title: Iambic goes public with $150M IPO to accelerate clinical development of oncology pipeline
summary: Iambic Therapeutics’ IPO came in dead on target, bringing in $150 million for the AI biotech to fuel the clinical development of its oncology pipeline.

title: Vanda pauses social anxiety program after ex-Novartis asset flunks phase 3 study
summary: A phase 3 trial of Vanda Pharmaceuticals’ social anxiety disorder drug candidate has missed its primary endpoint, prompting the company to put the program on hold.

title: Why OMass’ $310M series C marks ‘fantastic milestone’ on journey to become ‘Britain’s Big Biotech’
summary: When Fierce last caught up with OMass Therapeutics’ CEO Ros Deegan, it was hard not to be impressed by the company’s ambition.

title: IQVIA, Veeva expand on existing partnership for speedier clinical trials
summary: Clinical research giant IQVIA and cloud system provider Veeva Systems have expanded their partnership to further increase trial speed and efficiency.

title: Merck KGaA spinout iOnctura touts PI3K delta inhibitor in metastatic eye cancer
summary: iOnctura’s PI3K delta inhibitor shows promise in phase 1 study in patients with mostly pre-treated metastatic melanoma.

title: Verastem CEO claims RAS drug has 'set a new benchmark' for tricky cancer in early readout
summary: Verastem Oncology's decision to refocus its R&D efforts on its KRAS inhibitor appears to be paying off, at least based on initial data from a phase 1/2 trial.

title: Deep-pocketed Verdiva axes GLP-1 switching trial over ‘market evolution’
summary: Verdiva Bio has scrapped a phase 2 trial of its once-weekly oral GLP-1 drug candidate VRB-101, pulling the plug the year after launching with $410 million.

title: Biomea posts phase 1 data to pitch oral GLP-1 to potential partners, but investors appear unconvinced
summary: Biomea Fusion has shared phase 1 data on its oral GLP-1 prospect, shedding light on a small molecule designed to balance efficacy and gastrointestinal tolerability. Management hailed the data as a launchpad for talks with potential partners, but investors drove down the share price of the cash-strapped biotech.

title: Vir CEO sees ‘opportunity to do more deals’ after striking $1.9B Gilead pact for dual-masked TCEs
summary: Looking to expand its oncology portfolio, Gilead has tapped Vir Biotechnology’s masked T-cell engager tech in a potential $1.9 billion biobucks deal.

title: GSK to lay off over 1,200 roles in Belgium as cost-saving program picks up steam
summary: Up to 1,217 GSK employees in Belgium are at risk of losing their jobs as the Big Pharma rolls out its global cost-saving plans.

title: Zealand inks $1.2B Generate pact to add multispecific proteins to obesity pipeline
summary: Zealand Pharma is paying Generate Biomedicines $30 million upfront to collaborate on multispecific drug candidates for metabolic diseases. Milestones could bring the total value of the deal above $1 billion.

title: Agilent spends $240M upfront to buy digital pathology specialist Proscia
summary: Agilent Technologies is buying up the digital pathology software company Proscia in an all-cash transaction valued at $240 million with an additional $30 million on the cards for future performance milestones.

title: Stryker pens deal with CMR Surgical to advance robotic-assisted surgery
summary: Stryker will funnel around $400 million (£300 million) in a “strategic” investment in CMR Surgical and its robot surgery tech.

title: WCG unveils AI-powered solution to accelerate clinical trial kickoffs
summary: WCG, a clinical trials solutions provider, is launching an AI-powered program dubbed Activation Intelligence to help study sites accelerate clinical trial start-up.

title: Insulet’s Omnipod Discover platform sees full market release in US
summary: Insulet Corporation has announced the U.S. full market release of Omnipod Discover, a web-based data platform designed for Omnipod 5.

title: BioNTech’s mRNA cancer vaccine fails phase 3 test, significantly denting analysts’ confidence
summary: A phase 2/3 clinical trial of BioNTech’s mRNA cancer immunotherapy BNT113 has missed one of its dual primary endpoints. But with immature overall survival data offering a path to redemption, the German biotech is continuing to track patients in the metastatic head and neck cancer study.

title: Biotech builder Paragon imports Apogee's top brass after AbbVie buyout
summary: It’s been a busy morning for Paragon Labs. In addition to bringing over much of the leadership team from AbbVie-acquired Apogee Therapeutics, Paragon has overseen a reverse merger to take its hypertension-focused spinout Velaris Therapeutics public.

title: Roche inks $1.2B deal with China's Rona to enter emerging ALK7 obesity race
summary: Roche has committed $100 million in upfront and near-term payments to license Rona Therapeutics’ ALK7 drug candidate, joining Alnylam, Arrowhead, GSK and Novo Nordisk in an emerging obesity niche.

title: Pfizer pens $500M Enodia pact to join Lilly in emerging protein degrader field
summary: Pfizer has followed Eli Lilly into the Sec61 space, inking a $500 million deal with Enodia Therapeutics days after its Big Pharma peer formed an $870 million pact with Gate Bioscience.

title: Nurix drops one BTK degrader as momentum builds behind Roche-partnered option
summary: Nurix’s BTK degrader zelebrudomide may have survived a clinical hold in recent years, but that hasn’t stopped the California biotech from dropping the cancer drug.

title: Roche sets sights on FDA approval decision of July 2027 with updated eye drug data
summary: One year on from a mixed phase 3 readout, Roche has shared updated data from eye disease trials that could support FDA approval by July.

title: Tortugas’ schizophrenia drug proves worth in phase 2 Hansoh trial in China
summary: Tortugas Neuroscience’s schizophrenia drug from Hansoh Pharma has proven its worth in a phase 2b study, validating the fledgling biotech’s neurology strategy.
